web.heroTitle: Doctors, medicines, lab tests and a 24×7 SOS for every home
web.heroBody: {{brand}} brings home healthcare to gated communities, apartments, families, senior-living homes and employers.

console.title: {{brand}} console

console.notStaff: This account has no console access. Ask a super admin to add a role.

console.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
console.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the current one.

residents.title: Residents
residents.search: Search by name, home or community
residents.phoneNote: Personal numbers are hidden from staff. Calls go through the app.
residents.consentsNote: Only the resident can change these, in their app.
residents.medical_granted: The resident lets the care team see their readings.
residents.medical_not_granted: The resident has not asked the care team to watch their readings, so medical details are not shown.
residents.medical_not_permitted: Community desk accounts never see medical details.
residents.viewLogged: Your view of this profile is recorded.

cc.livePaused: Live updates paused. Refreshing every 10 seconds.

alarm.prompt_108: {{ref}}: no crew in time. Make sure 108 is called.

cc.mapA11y: {{incidents}} open emergencies and {{crews}} ambulances with a known position
cc.mapNote: Relative positions only. A street map needs the Google Maps key.
cc.noLocation: No location from the phone; dispatching to the home address.
cc.handoverPending: Coming next: the receiving hospital and what was shared with it, within the resident’s consent.
cc.cancelHint: Only for a false alarm, or when the resident is safe.
cc.reassignHint: Takes the job back from this crew and alerts the nearest crews again, with the usual 30 s / 90 s escalation.
cc.offerHint: Rings the crew’s phone like any offer. The first crew to accept gets the job.
cc.noFreeCrews: No free crews on duty right now.
cc.handOverHint: Only when the crew cannot mark it themselves.
cc.closeHintReason: Give a reason when closing before hand-over (for example, treated at home).
cc.watchOnly: Your role can watch incidents but not change them.
cc.testBody: A drill runs the whole flow for a community: offered only to drill crews and labelled DRILL everywhere. Families and hospitals get no messages.
cc.noSites: No communities are assigned to you.
cc.fleetEmpty: No ambulance crews are set up yet.
cc.recentEmpty: Nothing closed in the last day.

thresholds.title: SOS thresholds
thresholds.intro: How long each community waits before widening the search to more ambulances, and before prompting a 108 call. Changes apply to the next SOS, never one in progress, and are logged.
thresholds.readOnly: Only a super admin can change thresholds.

coverage.title: Coverage teams
coverage.intro: A team of crews and an ambulance covers communities, buildings and stand-alone homes. An SOS from a covered home rings that team first, topped up with the nearest other crews.
coverage.name: Team name
coverage.empty: No teams yet. Create one, then add crews and assign places.
coverage.noCrews: No crew in this team yet.
coverage.noAmbulances: No ambulance in this team yet.
coverage.deactivateHint: An inactive team is not offered SOS first; its places fall back to the nearest crews.

auth.phoneTitle: Sign in with your mobile number
auth.whatsappNotice: We'll also send booking and service updates on WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.
auth.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.useSms: Get the code by SMS instead
auth.fieldOnly: This app is for field staff. Ask your supervisor to add your number, then sign in again.

consent.screenBody: You decide who sees your health information. You can change any of these later in Profile → Privacy.

care_record.title: Keep my health record
care_record.body: Store my readings, conditions, allergies, medicines and reports so the app can show them to me and provide the services I ask for. Nobody else sees them unless I allow it below or when booking.

emergency_share.title: Share my records with the hospital in an emergency
emergency_share.body: If I raise an SOS, send my blood group, allergies, conditions, medicines, last readings, emergency contacts and insurance to the receiving hospital through a secure link that expires. If this is off, only my blood group is sent.

family_sos_alert.title: Alert my family on every SOS
family_sos_alert.body: Tell my emergency contacts that an SOS was raised and when help is on the way. They never receive medical details.

proactive_care.title: Let the care team watch over my readings
proactive_care.body: The care team may review my readings and contact me if something looks wrong or a check-up is due. If this is off, I am never included in risk lists or alerts.

reminders.title: Medicine reminders
reminders.body: Remind me when a dose is due.

manager.title: Let {{name}} manage my care
manager.body: {{name}} can see my health record, book services and record readings for me. Everything they do is recorded, and I can remove them at any time.

doctor_share.title: Share with the doctor
doctor_share.body: The doctor sees only what I tick here, for this consult only.

whatsapp_updates.title: WhatsApp updates
whatsapp_updates.body: We'll also send booking and service updates on WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.

health.byOther: entered by family or care team

onboarding.householdBody: Join your community with the code from your association, or set up your own home.
onboarding.codeHint: From your association or community desk
onboarding.consentRequired: Keeping your health record is needed to use the health features.

location.title: Let help find you
location.body: When you press SOS, your location goes to the ambulance crew and the community desk so they can reach you fast.
location.when: Your location is never tracked in the background. It is read once, at the moment you ask for help.
location.later: You can change this any time in your phone settings. Without it, help is sent to your home address.

healthTab.title: My health
healthTab.trendEmpty: Log a few readings to see a trend.

sos.confirmLead: Alerting ambulances and the community desk in
sos.confirmNote: Your location is shared with the responding crew. Your medical details go to the hospital only as your consent settings allow.
sos.slow: Still trying to reach us. Call now if you need help:
sos.refused: Your SOS could not be sent. Please call now:
sos.cancelConfirm: Cancel this SOS? The ambulance and desk will be told you are OK.
sos.liveOff: Live updates paused. Checking every few seconds.

subtitle.dispatching: Alerting the nearest ambulances. Stay where you are.
subtitle.escalated_to_108: No ambulance has accepted yet. We are still trying.
subtitle.on_scene: The crew is looking after you.
subtitle.transporting: The crew is taking you to hospital.
subtitle.handed_over: The hospital team has taken over.

sos.escalatedBanner: No ambulance has accepted in time. Call 108 now; we will keep looking and tell you if one accepts.
sos.mapA11yNone: Your location. No ambulance position yet.
sos.mapNote: Straight-line distance. Street map coming soon.
sos.erPending: Shown here once a hospital is chosen. Only what your consent settings allow is shared.
